book.name: James
book.title: Soo James ka Mu Jew Numu-matoo Tubo

content: E pupua'amu, huu'yoosoo tamme-nagatu sakwa numu nanesootuhibu tunedyooedu mane. Soo Te Naa mu numu nanesootuhi tutunedyooedu unu tunakabetsea manena soogwa'e, no'oko numu ooonakwasoo.
No'yoona tamme tune'emukwa. Soo tooe haga tooe gi tune'emukwudu tookwa tubetse besa'yoo.

Soo numu ego puu tuutse'yoo pana tooe ka tuutsekoo hemma paba mesoo nemadabue. Soo natzipu puu tuutse'yoo pana tamme ka pookoo tupa-wi oo hanese, soo pookoo te nakabetseana tooe howtoo tooe pumme te tzamuna, tamme soomane-kwa'nesoo manenumme.
Soo sake natzakohakunoo puu tuutse'yoo pana ka sake tzamuna, ka tutzidu soomane-kwa'ne tooe unu tu hukwa sapa. Umu-wa'ne'yoo soo numu ego tuutse'yoo pana ewa suta-kwi numu nemayukwe.

Tuutse'yoo goso puu paba haano-kwi tooe hemma tooe nikute. Mu numu ego ka goso-wa'ne'yoo. Soo suta numu ego neyugwedu ka teepu-toohatu ooosapa nidabedu gi tookedu goso-nakwana kemmadu. Soo te ego no'oko te tookoo totsaba ge'a ka suda te mane tuunguna.
No'obatusoo hemma modu soo numu mesoo madusooyookute: hootseba'a tooe togogwa sapa tuwazoo.
Pana tooe haga tooe gi hownnekoo pummesoo ego unikwuna tzi-wa'ne'yoo. Oosoo numu ego puu ewa nanasuda numu unekute.

Susumana tamme oo-ma Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhina, yise susumana te pupu'amu nesootze'ma, oo namanedu gi besa'yoo. Tamme sakwa gi numu nesootzemapana, ka Te Naa mu numu pu-kwa'nesoo mu matabuese. Tamme sakwa gi Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhina numu nesootzemapana nano'o-kwizoo.
E pupua'amu, nu sakwa besasoo mu tuukwe tabua. Sumu'yoo patzona puu besa kamadu baa-gana, gi osa kamadu baa-ga-wa'ne'yoo tuwazoo.
Sumu'yoo tumasuape pu gi nanakumma'akoosoo suakute. Soo osa baa puu gi hannano'o besa kama-wa'ne'yoo. Tamme sakwa gi Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhina numu nesootzemapana nano'o-kwizoo.

Tamme numu nanesootuhibu tunedyooedu ka kaahenotu soopedakwadoona, gi sakwa paba nasooyukwepana. Tamme sakwa ka mu numu tzapoonneku ka Te Naa besa podo te meana, ka gi nanahana, gi numu ooonakwasoo besa nasooyugwena.
Tamme ka nanahana, numu ooonakwasoo besa nasooyukwena, tamme ka toge na'unepu gi nakabetsea.
Tamme ka nanahana oo-koobatoo paba nasooyugwena, tamme gi ka Te Naa toge unnepu nakabetse'a, pana tamme mu numu tumaduguna ka kwase-gakoo unena tamme nakabetsea.
Soo numu ka puusoo besa nasooyukwena numu ooonakwasoo, umu tooe how tooe nanasuda manena nananuusoogweduna mu numu yise ooweoo nanaha'a.

Tamme ka Te Naa kaaheno unnepu nakabetseana, tamme yooonne'yoo: gi totsa'a, gi nanano nanaha'a, besa numu matugu, besa numu nakasoopedakwadoo, numu tumatzina, ka toge-kwitu soopedakwadoona, kaaheno'yoona.
Umu gi tu nanakwohonena petzabedu, nananosoo besa hemma hanekwu, oosoo yise umu-matoo kodyuka umu yise besa'yookwu.
